policy.training_requirement: Do not use a clip for training until its dataset or copyright license explicitly permits that use.
policy.legal_notice: Labels are review targets, not legal conclusions.

split_policy.training: Only explicitly licensed and manually reviewed clips may enter training.
split_policy.validation: Use source-disjoint clips for tuning thresholds and geometry.
split_policy.external_validation: May be used to compare tracker or threshold candidates, but never for model training.
split_policy.holdout: Never train, inspect, or tune on holdout clips before reporting generalization results.
split_policy.source_isolation: Clips from the same original uploader, long video, or scene must stay in one split.
